PCCyclus.title: PCCyclus
PCCyclus.description: A Planning & Control cyclus: one governance body's recurring annual decision/document cycle for a single execution year, generated from a CyclusTemplate. Municipal: kadernota -> programmabegroting -> bestuursrapportage(s) -> jaarrekening; association/corporate analogue: jaarplan -> begroting -> tussenrapportage -> jaarstukken + decharge. A PCCyclus binds one governanceBody, one execution year, and one template; its CyclusStap objects are generated from the template step list and tracked from aanlevering through behandeling to vaststelling. This capability owns the recurring document/decision cycle; meeting-series keeps owning recurring meetings and vve-alv-pack keeps owning statutory decision templates (hard boundary). NOTE (design D4): year is the EXECUTION year (when the steps happen), not the subject year; each step's betreftJaar = year + template subjectYearOffset. NOTE (design D3): stepCount/completedStepCount/overdueStepCount are materialised progress aggregations over the child steps that consumers read and MUST NOT recompute client-side.

year.title: Execution year
year.description: Execution year in which the cyclus steps happen (design D4). One cyclus per calendar year per governance body. Required. Not the subject year: each step's betreftJaar = year + the template step's subjectYearOffset.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (raad / ALV) that runs this cyclus. Required.

template.title: Template
template.description: Reference to the CyclusTemplate the steps were generated from. Required. A template edit affects future generations only and never regenerates an in-flight cyclus (design D5).

stepCount.title: Step count
stepCount.description: Materialised aggregation (design D3): total number of CyclusStap objects in this cyclus. Consumers read this value; they SHALL NOT recompute it client-side.

completedStepCount.title: Completed step count
completedStepCount.description: Materialised aggregation (design D3): number of steps in a terminal status (vastgesteld or afgerond). Read, never recomputed.

overdueStepCount.title: Overdue step count
overdueStepCount.description: Materialised aggregation (design D3): number of non-terminal steps whose aanleverDeadline lies in the past. Read, never recomputed; also surfaced by the dashboard KPI.

CyclusTemplate.title: CyclusTemplate
CyclusTemplate.description: A reusable calendar step list for a Planning & Control cyclus: the ordered step types, default month/day dates, subject-year offsets, and document slots a governance body follows each year. Follows the process-configuration built-in-template pattern (builtIn seeds, read-only-but-duplicable), but is a DISTINCT schema from ProcessTemplate (43-process-config): a ProcessTemplate models a decision state machine; a CyclusTemplate models a calendar step list (design D2). CONSTRAINT (design D5): editing/deleting a built-in template (builtIn true) is refused server-side; duplication into an editable copy (fresh slug, builtIn cleared) is allowed. Editing a template never regenerates an in-flight cyclus. This read-only-built-in guard is enforced at save time (imperative, mirroring ProcessTemplateService), documented here.

context.title: Context
context.description: Governance context this template is intended for.

builtIn.title: Built-in
builtIn.description: Read-only built-in template shipped with the app (design D5). Edit and delete are refused server-side; duplicate is allowed and clears this flag.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Ordered list of template steps. Required. Generation resolves each step's default month/day into a concrete date within the cyclus execution year and copies the document slots.

stepType.title: Step type
stepType.description: Canonical values kadernota, begroting, berap, jaarrekening, jaarplan, jaarstukken, decharge. NOT a closed enum: a duplicated template MAY declare a custom stepType.

subjectYearOffset.title: Subject-year offset
subjectYearOffset.description: Offset added to the cyclus execution year to derive betreftJaar (design D4). kadernota/begroting +1, berap 0, jaarrekening/jaarstukken/decharge -1.

deliveryDeadline.title: Aanlever-deadline default
deliveryDeadline.description: Default month/day (MM-DD) the organisation must deliver the documents; resolved into a concrete date within the cyclus year at generation. Optional (a decharge step may have none).

technicalQuestionsStart.title: Technische-vragen start default
technicalQuestionsStart.description: Default month/day (MM-DD) the technical-questions window opens. Optional.

technicalQuestionsEnd.title: Technische-vragen end default
technicalQuestionsEnd.description: Default month/day (MM-DD) the technical-questions window closes. Optional.

committeeDate.title: Commissie date default
committeeDate.description: Default month/day (MM-DD) of the behandelende-commissie target. Optional.

handlingDate.title: Behandeling date default
handlingDate.description: Default month/day (MM-DD) of the raad/ALV behandeling target. Optional.

documentSlots.title: Document slots
documentSlots.description: Document slots copied onto each generated step.

name.title: Slot name
name.description: Name of the document slot (e.g. Programmabegroting).

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether a delivered document is required for this slot.

CyclusStap.title: CyclusStap
CyclusStap.description: One step of a Planning & Control cyclus, generated from a CyclusTemplate step and tracked from aanlevering through behandeling to vaststelling. Related to its parent PCCyclus (one cyclus -> many steps, ordered by sequence). Cross-references the ordinary AgendaItem (once behandeling is scheduled) and the ordinary Decision (once the vaststellingsbesluit exists); the step NEVER creates meetings, agenda items or decisions itself: scheduling stays with agenda-management, decision content with decision-management/decision-route. Decharge is recorded as an outcome, not a decision template (VvE statutory templates stay in vve-alv-pack). CONSTRAINT: steps carry NO financial figures or monetary properties by construction. The status workflow is declared exclusively in x-openregister-lifecycle and the rappels exclusively in x-openregister-notifications (ADR-031); no app-side state machine and no bespoke reminder BackgroundJob.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-PCC-005). Canonical dialect verbatim (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). gepland -> stukken-ontvangen -> in-behandeling -> vastgesteld | afgerond, plus stukken-ontvangen -> afgerond for steps without a formal vaststelling (e.g. a berap ter kennisname). vastgesteld and afgerond terminal. No app-side state machine.

aanleveringLate._note: Late-aanlevering rappel (REQ-PCC-006). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — admin-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets status 'gepland' only, so no rappel fires for terminal (vastgesteld/afgerond) or in-progress steps. LIMITATION: the 'aanleverDeadline is past' predicate is not expressible in this filter shape; the scheduled engine's window semantics carry it — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets this as an after-deadline rappel during live import. Recipients approximate the griffie via object-acl(read) + the decidesk-members group.

subject.nl: Rappel: behandeling P&C-stap nog niet geagendeerd — {{label}}
subject.en: Reminder: P&C step behandeling not yet scheduled — {{label}}

behandelingApproachingUnscheduled._note: Behandeling-approaching-unscheduled rappel (REQ-PCC-006). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filter targets non-terminal status only, so no rappel fires for vastgesteld/afgerond. LIMITATION (design D6/open question): the 'behandelingDatum within the rappel window' and 'agendaItem reference empty' predicates are not expressible in this filter shape; the scheduled engine's window semantics carry the date, and the empty-agendaItem condition is a documented apply-time concern — verify against OR's scheduled-notification engine during live import; never a silent gap and never an imperative reminder BackgroundJob.

cyclus.title: Cyclus
cyclus.description: Reference to the parent PCCyclus. Required. One cyclus -> many steps, ordered by sequence.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Ordinal position within the cyclus, following the template step order. Required.

stepType.title: Step type
stepType.description: Canonical values kadernota, begroting, berap, jaarrekening, jaarplan, jaarstukken, decharge. NOT a closed enum: a duplicated template MAY declare a custom stepType, so this property is deliberately not constrained by an enum.

concernsYear.title: Subject year
concernsYear.description: Subject year the step concerns, derived at generation from the cyclus execution year + the template step's subjectYearOffset (design D4). E.g. in execution year 2026 a begroting step betreft 2027 and a jaarrekening step betreft 2025.

deliveryDeadline.title: Aanlever-deadline
deliveryDeadline.description: Date by which the organisation must deliver the documents. Drives the late-aanlevering rappel and the overdue dashboard KPI. Optional (a decharge step may have none).

technicalQuestionsStart.title: Technische-vragen start
technicalQuestionsStart.description: Start of the technical-questions window. Optional.

technicalQuestionsEnd.title: Technische-vragen end
technicalQuestionsEnd.description: End of the technical-questions window. Optional.

handlingCommittee.title: Behandelende commissie
handlingCommittee.description: Optional reference to the GovernanceBody (commissie) that pre-advises on this step.

committeeDate.title: Commissie date
committeeDate.description: Optional target date for the behandelende-commissie treatment.

decisionMakingBody.title: Besluitvormend orgaan
decisionMakingBody.description: Reference to the decision-making GovernanceBody (raad / ALV) that treats this step.

handlingDate.title: Behandeling date
handlingDate.description: Target date of the raad/ALV behandeling. Drives the behandeling-approaching-unscheduled rappel when agendaItem is still empty.

documentSlots.title: Document slots
documentSlots.description: Document slots copied from the template step. Each slot carries a name, a required flag, and the delivered file attached via OpenRegister's FileService: no app-local file storage.

name.title: Slot name
name.description: Name of the document slot (e.g. Programmabegroting).

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether a delivered document is required for this slot.

file.title: Delivered file
file.description: Reference to the delivered file attached via FileService. Empty until the document is delivered.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the actual AgendaItem once behandeling is scheduled. Set once the item is placed on a meeting agenda; the step never creates the AgendaItem itself. Empty means behandeling is not yet scheduled (drives the unscheduled rappel).

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Reference to the actual Decision (vaststellingsbesluit / decharge-besluit) once it exists. The step never creates the Decision itself; decision content stays in decision-management/decision-route.

status.title: Status
status.description: Step status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gepland -> stukken-ontvangen -> in-behandeling -> vastgesteld | afgerond, plus stukken-ontvangen -> afgerond. vastgesteld and afgerond are terminal.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Optional step outcome. For a decharge step: decharge-verleend or decharge-geweigerd; the resulting besluit lives in the normal Decision model via the decision reference. This capability defines no statutory decision templates.
